_about: Volumetric flow limits (filament_max_volumetric_speed, mm3/s) from the printer vendor's own filament presets in OrcaSlicer, by Gantrel printer key and filament family. The planner uses the vendor's Generic preset for that family; other presets for the same family on that machine (the vendor's own basic filament, high speed variants) are listed under 'also' for reference only. Inherited values are resolved through each preset's 'inherits' chain. Generated from a checkout of OrcaSlicer at the commit below.
